stance_basis: spokesperson neither endorsed nor condemned the Airport Spur but expressed concern about noise and air pollution effects on Hamlin Garland School
summary: Milwaukee Public Schools neither supported nor opposed the Airport Spur project, but expressed concern about the effects of air and noise pollution on Hamlin Garland School. The school system also conducted noise studies at Hamlin Garland School in 1970 and 1974, providing data used in the environmental analysis of the project's noise impacts.
complaint_summary: In a 1970 noise study conducted by Milwaukee Public Schools, noise measurements at Hamlin Garland School ranged from 69-90dBC, though these were not taken on the nationally accepted A-weighted scale and were not considered conclusive; a subsequent 1974 study by Milwaukee Public Schools recorded an L10 noise measurement of 64 dBA.
